notes: The pleonastic-looking οὐ of ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο is aligned to save: the ASV converts the negation into the exceptive word rather than dropping it, so rules 41 and 79 do not empty it.
of after speak stays inside λαλεῖν's unit: the object τι is accusative, which English realizes with no preposition, so the of is the verb's own phrasal government (rule 106).
